pages.text:
Conduit Filters decide what a conduit connection lets through. They fit Item, Fluid and Pressurized conduits.
# Installing
- Right-click a connection (the arm facing a machine or inventory) with a filter. One filter per connection.
- Right-click the filtered connection with an empty hand to open its settings.
- A Wrench in Dismantle mode (Shift + Right-click) takes the filter off. Its settings stay on the item, so you can reuse it.
# Settings
- 9 slots: click with an item to set it (the item isn't used up). On fluid and pressurized conduits, click with a bucket, Canister or Gas Cartridge to set its fluid or gas.
- Allowlist lets only the listed things through; Denylist lets everything else through.
- Each slot matches Exact, or by Tag: click the chip under a slot to cycle through that item's tags.
- Ignore components makes enchanted, damaged or renamed items match.
- Direction: filter when inserting into the machine, when extracting from it, or both.
# Routing
A filtered destination that rejects something is simply skipped; the rest still share the load in turn.
